novelty: Exact key-variable factorization/separator audit from ANF monomial co-occurrence; distinct from statistical selectors, counter derivatives, output projections, cubes and rotational distinguishers.
scope: controlled reduced ChaCha target-free forward-map structural falsifier
exact_anf: complete 2^b truth tables and exact packed GF(2) Mobius transform
primal_graph: vertices are logical key bits. For every nonzero ANF monomial coefficient in any output bit, connect every pair of key variables occurring in that monomial. Union over all 512 outputs.
hypergraph_diagnostics: whether the full-support degree-b monomial occurs in any output
separator_proxy: Enumerate every vertex separator S exactly. Remove S, compute connected components of the remaining primal graph, let M(S) be the largest component size (0 if none), and define alpha_sep_proxy = min_S (|S|+M(S))/b. This is only a Stage0 factorization proxy, not an admitted solver exponent.
stage1_only_if_pass: Freeze a concrete variable-elimination/dynamic-programming solver on fresh widths and bill factor construction, separator assignments, component solves, memory, collisions and exact verification in TOTAL. Only that later scaling may support alpha<1.
kill_rule: If any R6 primary gate fails, close straightforward ANF-primal-graph factorization. Do not cherry-pick output bits, delete monomials, threshold weak interactions or open a second graph definition.
secondary_control: R4 is diagnostic only and cannot rescue R6 failure.
forbidden: No target selection, approximate ANF, graph sparsification, output subset tuning, solver benchmark after Stage0 FAIL, or full-round claim.
